# agyn_group_membership (Resource)

Manages an Agyn group membership.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group identifier.
- `member_id` (String) Member identifier.
- `member_type` (String) Member type. One of `user`, `agent`, or `app`.

### Optional

- `source` (String) Membership source. One of `platform` or `scim`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the group membership.
